task.name: Many edge colors without a rainbow four-cycle
task.family: science prize d rainbow c4 avoidance
task.description: construct() -> 120 integer colors in 0..119 for the lexicographically ordered pairs (i,j), 0<=i<j<16. No four-cycle may have four distinct edge colors. Maximize the number of colors actually used; all three cycles on every four-vertex subset are checked. The n=16, cycle-length-four task searches extremal colorings for a solved finite specialization, using an independently written exhaustive verifier.
